description: Parse and semantically validate a .bpc source. Returns { valid, errors[], warnings[] }. Errors include unknown chart types, unknown properties, and empty data blocks with nearest-neighbour suggestions.

source.description: The .bpc chart source to parse and validate.

name: validate_dsl

items.description: A validation error or warning entry.

context.description: Structured error context (e.g. the offending value and the set of known values).

path.description: Dotted path to the offending node, or empty string.

suggestion.description: Actionable fix, when one is known.

valid.description: True when the source parses and passes semantic validation.
